status_reason: The exact Blorenge Common CL18 boundary and an incident-authority chronology are not yet available under verified public-reuse terms.

area_of_interest.intended_rule: Geometric union of the Blorenge SSSI and Blorenge Common CL18, buffered by 2000 metres in EPSG:27700.

missing_component.name: Blorenge Common
missing_component.reason: Blorenge Common is urban common. The NRW Open Access - Registered Common Land dataset explicitly omits urban commons and contains no feature that can stand in for CL18.
missing_component.required_action: Obtain the maintained CL18 register map or GIS boundary and written public display/derivative-reuse terms from the registration authority. Do not substitute nearby NRW_COMMON_LAND_2014 features.

temporary_discovery_envelopes.use_limit: Discovery and over-acquisition only. Neither envelope is a publishable AOI geometry.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap Wales extract
sources.purpose: Community-maintained basemap, place names, roads, tracks and paths; never a definitive public-rights-of-way record.

upstream.cadence: daily latest extract; dated snapshots retained by provider
upstream.refresh_policy: Quarterly candidate refresh; manual review of material path/place/basemap changes.

licence.obligations: Make the ODbL clear, comply with attribution guidance, and treat a distributed adapted database or PMTiles database as ODbL/share-alike where applicable.

sources.transformation: Clip to the final AOI, retain OSM identifiers and relevant access/path tags, omit contributor metadata, build self-hosted PMTiles, and label all paths as contextual rather than legal rights of way.
known_gaps: Community completeness and currency vary.
Path tags do not establish legal status.
Welsh names may be incomplete.

sources.title: Welsh Government LiDAR 1 m DTM
sources.purpose: Terrain hillshade and contours plus terrain-shadow QA.

acquisition.method: WFS tile-catalogue query then HTTPS GeoTIFF download

upstream.cadence: survey programme, not a routine live feed
upstream.refresh_policy: Annual catalogue and licence review; rebuild only for a materially better source edition.

licence.note: The map/download resource is OGL although the standalone tile-catalogue metadata says 'Not Specified'; retain a snapshot of the OGL map terms with every release.

schema.geometry: 1 km tile catalogue polygons and 1000 x 1000 float32 GeoTIFF tiles

sources.transformation: Select tiles intersecting the final AOI, mosaic DTM values without DSM substitution, derive fixed hillshade and labelled contours, clip to AOI and retain the source DTM privately for reproducibility.
known_gaps: Capture date varies by tile.
The provider warns the data was not produced specifically for flood modelling.
Final tile set cannot be fixed until CL18 is obtained.

sources.title: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Collection-1 Level-2A
sources.purpose: Primary source observations for provisional extent and continuous dNBR, NDVI and NDMI change evidence.

acquisition.method: CDSE STAC discovery followed by authenticated build-time S3 or OData asset retrieval

upstream.refresh_policy: Re-query weekly while evidence is active, then quarterly; check product deletion, anomaly and reprocessing notices before every promotion.

schema.nodata: SCL and product masks; preserve explicit not-observed state

sources.transformation: Apply provider scale and offset, per-pixel masks and disclosed adjacency dilation; retain native analytic support; assess terrain shadow; compute continuous indicators; preserve observation date and contributing count per pixel.
known_gaps: No item can be assigned a final temporal role until incident chronology is verified.
Whole-tile cloud percentage is discovery metadata, not AOI acceptance evidence.
CDSE binary asset access requires a free authenticated build identity.

sources.title: USGS Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance Tier 1
sources.purpose: Independent 30 m corroboration of surface-change direction and extent.

acquisition.method: USGS STAC discovery and HTTPS COG range/full retrieval

upstream.refresh_policy: Re-query weekly while evidence is active, then quarterly; check known-issues and reprocessing notices before promotion.

licence.attribution: Landsat imagery courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

sources.transformation: Apply published scale/offset, mask fill/cloud/shadow/snow/saturation/terrain occlusion, clip to AOI, keep 30 m support and use as corroboration rather than a fused higher-resolution product.
known_gaps: No item can be assigned a final temporal role until incident chronology is verified.
Whole-scene cloud percentage is not AOI acceptance evidence.
Overlapping paths have different geometry and should be compared like-for-like where possible.

upstream.cadence: current-season database updated in near real time
upstream.refresh_policy: Snapshot weekly until stable, then before every evidence promotion; compare identifier, geometry, dates, area and class.

licence.attribution: European Union, Copernicus EFFIS; changes and clipping by Blorenge Commoners Association indicated

sources.transformation: Extract id 592404, preserve provider geometry and fields, clip only for display, and publish as a separate EFFIS provisional comparison. Never union it with a BCA-derived or authority boundary.
known_gaps: EFFIS dates are provider product dates, not verified ignition, control or extinction times.
The candidate lies immediately south of the Blorenge SSSI and must be matched to an incident-authority record before being named as the July 2026 Blorenge fire.
EFFIS does not distinguish wildfire from prescribed or environmental burning and may omit small islands or scars.

hard_gaps.required_evidence: Maintained CL18 boundary plus written public display, transformation and derivative-reuse terms.
Incident start, control/containment and end chronology; event location/identifier; any surveyed boundary; source status; and written republication terms.
